fact: Car 44 allegedly impeded Car 10 on the approach to Turn 8.
offence: Alleged breach of Article B4.1.1 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 44 (Lewis Hamilton), the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 44 explained that he was under the impression that Car 10 was not on a push lap, and his team confirmed that it had the same opinion. The driver and team representative of Car 10 stated they did not consider this to be a case of "unnecessary impeding". The Stewards therefore determined to take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 44 Alleged Impeding Of Car 10
to: The Team Manager, Scuderia Ferrari HP
